source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica, l’essiccatore deve essere messo in funzione manualmente dal conducente

records.localized_text: In pneumatic-braked vehicles, the driver must start the dryer manually.

source.text_it: Nell’essiccatore di un impianto frenante pneumatico, una volta "asciugata" l’aria, vengono aggiunte piccole particelle di lubrificante per oliare le valvole del circuito dell’aria compressa

records.localized_text: In a pneumatic brake dryer, small lubricant particles are added after drying air to oil air-circuit valves.

source.text_it: Nell’impianto di frenatura pneumatico, vi sono tanti essiccatori quanti sono i serbatoi dell’aria compressa

records.localized_text: A pneumatic braking system has one dryer for each compressed-air tank.

source.text_it: Negli impianti di frenatura ad aria compressa, il regolatore di pressione permette di mantenere l’aria dei circuiti frenanti ad una pressione compresa tra due valori, massimo e minimo

records.localized_text: In compressed-air brakes, the pressure regulator keeps circuit pressure between maximum and minimum values.

source.text_it: Negli impianti di frenatura ad aria compressa, il regolatore di pressione permette di evitare sovrappressioni nell’impianto

records.localized_text: In compressed-air brakes, the pressure regulator prevents system overpressure.

source.text_it: Negli impianti di frenatura ad aria compressa, il regolatore di pressione è dotato di una valvola di sicurezza

records.localized_text: In compressed-air brakes, the pressure regulator has a safety valve.

source.text_it: Negli impianti di frenatura ad aria compressa, il regolatore di pressione prevede anche fasi di funzionamento a vuoto del compressore

records.localized_text: In compressed-air brakes, the pressure regulator also provides compressor idle phases.

source.text_it: Negli impianti di frenatura ad aria compressa, il regolatore di pressione prevede anche fasi in cui scarica aria in atmosfera

records.localized_text: In compressed-air brakes, the pressure regulator also has phases when it vents air to atmosphere.

source.text_it: Negli impianti di frenatura ad aria compressa, il regolatore di pressione permette di mantenere l’aria dei circuiti frenanti alla pressione fissa di quindici bar

records.localized_text: In compressed-air brakes, the pressure regulator keeps brake-circuit air at a fixed 15 bar.

source.text_it: Negli impianti di frenatura ad aria compressa, il regolatore di pressione ha il compito di regolare il valore della pressione dell’aria inviata agli elementi frenanti

records.localized_text: In compressed-air brakes, the pressure regulator adjusts pressure sent to brake components.

source.text_it: Negli impianti di frenatura ad aria compressa, il regolatore di pressione ha il compito di regolare il valore della pressione dell’aria all'interno delle sospensioni pneumatiche

records.localized_text: In compressed-air brakes, the pressure regulator adjusts air suspension pressure.

source.text_it: Negli impianti di frenatura ad aria compressa, il regolatore di pressione non è necessario se il veicolo è dotato di sospensioni pneumatiche

records.localized_text: In compressed-air brakes, a pressure regulator is unnecessary if the vehicle has air suspension.

source.text_it: Negli impianti di frenatura ad aria compressa, il regolatore di pressione è comandato dal conducente attraverso apposito "manettino" posto sul cruscotto

records.localized_text: In compressed-air brakes, the driver operates the pressure regulator using a dashboard hand control.

source.text_it: Gli elementi frenanti dei veicoli stradali possono essere del tipo a tamburo e ganasce dotate di guarnizione di attrito (ferodo)

records.localized_text: Road vehicle brakes may use drums and shoes with friction lining.

source.text_it: Gli elementi frenanti dei veicoli stradali possono essere del tipo a disco e pastiglie dotate di guarnizione di attrito (ferodo)

records.localized_text: Road vehicle brakes may use discs and pads with friction lining.

source.text_it: Gli elementi frenanti dei veicoli stradali pesanti sono del tipo ad attrito

records.localized_text: Heavy road vehicle brake components are friction type.

source.text_it: Gli elementi frenanti dei veicoli possono avere problemi di surriscaldamento

records.localized_text: Vehicle brake components can overheat.

source.text_it: Gli elementi frenanti dei veicoli, trasformano l’energia cinetica posseduta dal veicolo in calore da disperdere in atmosfera

records.localized_text: Vehicle brake components convert kinetic energy into heat dissipated into the atmosphere.

source.text_it: Gli elementi frenanti possono essere del tipo a disco e ganasce dotate di guarnizione di attrito (ferodo)

records.localized_text: Brake components may use discs and shoes with friction lining.

source.text_it: Gli elementi frenanti possono essere del tipo a ganasce e pastiglie dotate di guarnizione di attrito (ferodo)

records.localized_text: Brake components may use shoes and pads with friction lining.

source.text_it: Gli elementi frenanti dei veicoli possono avere problemi di eccessiva ventilazione

records.localized_text: Vehicle brake components can suffer excessive ventilation.

source.text_it: Gli elementi frenanti dei veicoli stradali pesanti sono del tipo elettromagnetico

records.localized_text: Heavy road vehicle brake components are electromagnetic.

source.text_it: I veicoli stradali di massa complessiva a pieno carico superiore a 7,5 tonnellate, devono essere dotati di elementi frenanti raffreddati a liquido

records.localized_text: Road vehicles with total laden mass over 7.5 tonnes must have liquid-cooled brake components.

source.text_it: I veicoli stradali di massa complessiva a pieno carico superiore a 3,5 tonnellate, non possono essere dotati di elementi frenanti autoventilanti per pericolo di rottura del disco

records.localized_text: Road vehicles with total laden mass over 3.5 tonnes cannot have self-ventilated brakes because the disc may break.

source.text_it: Il freno di tipo pneumoidraulico funziona grazie all'azione combinata dell'aria e dell'olio

records.localized_text: A pneumatic-hydraulic brake works through the combined action of air and oil.

rows.text: The dryer operates automatically in the compressed-air supply circuit; the driver does not have to start it by hand.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/air_processing_maintenance_manuals_/MM35_web_1.pdf p. 2, “How the System Saver Twin Air Dryer Works”: il regolatore avvia automaticamente il compressore sotto la soglia e l’aria attraversa l’essiccatore, avviando il ciclo di essiccazione.

rows.text: The dryer removes moisture and can separate oil aerosols; it does not add lubricant to the air going to the valves.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64542.html: essiccatore separa umidità e aerosol di olio; include regolatore e valvola di spurgo.

rows.text: One dryer can treat air upstream of several reservoirs; there need not be one dryer per reservoir.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/air_processing_maintenance_manuals_/MM35_web_1.pdf p. 2, figura 1.2: un essiccatore alimenta un serbatoio di alimentazione e due serbatoi dell’impianto.

rows.text: The governor controls air production between cut-in and cut-out thresholds, replenishing pressure when it falls.
evidence: https://www.wabco-customercentre.com/catalog/docs/8150102173.pdf §6.1.1.1: regolatore 975 303 controlla automaticamente la pressione e comprende valvola di sicurezza integrata.

https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/air_processing_maintenance_manuals_/MM1736_web.pdf §4.2.5: il regolatore comanda carico e scarico del compressore alle soglie di pressione.
https://dld.utah.gov/cdl-manual-section-5-air-brakes/ §§5.1.2, 5.1.7: soglie di intervento del regolatore; il pedale modula la pressione di frenatura.

rows.text: At the upper threshold the governor unloads the compressor, limiting supply pressure; a safety valve protects against excess pressure.
evidence: https://www.wabco-customercentre.com/catalog/docs/8150102173.pdf §6.1.1.1: regolatore 975 303 controlla automaticamente la pressione e comprende valvola di sicurezza integrata.

https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/air_processing_maintenance_manuals_/MM1736_web.pdf §4.2.5: il regolatore comanda carico e scarico del compressore alle soglie di pressione.

rows.text: The governor considered here has a safety valve that operates if pressure becomes excessive.
evidence: https://www.wabco-customercentre.com/catalog/docs/8150102173.pdf §6.1.1.1: regolatore 975 303 controlla automaticamente la pressione e comprende valvola di sicurezza integrata.

rows.text: At the upper threshold the governor unloads the compressor; when pressure falls to the lower threshold, loading resumes.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/air_processing_maintenance_manuals_/MM1736_web.pdf §4.2.5: il regolatore comanda carico e scarico del compressore alle soglie di pressione.
https://dld.utah.gov/cdl-manual-section-5-air-brakes/ §§5.1.2, 5.1.7: soglie di intervento del regolatore; il pedale modula la pressione di frenatura.

rows.text: At cut-out pressure the governor can vent air to the atmosphere; venting stops when pressure falls to the cut-in threshold.
evidence: https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150100033.pdf p. 15, Combined Unloader 975 303, funzionamento a): alla pressione di disinserimento l’aria del compressore esce allo scarico 3; sotto la pressione di reinserimento l’uscita si chiude e riprende il riempimento.

rows.text: Supply pressure varies between cut-in and cut-out thresholds; it is not held fixed at 15 bar.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/air_processing_maintenance_manuals_/MM1736_web.pdf §4.2.5: il regolatore comanda carico e scarico del compressore alle soglie di pressione.
https://dld.utah.gov/cdl-manual-section-5-air-brakes/ §§5.1.2, 5.1.7: soglie di intervento del regolatore; il pedale modula la pressione di frenatura.

rows.text: The governor controls reservoir supply pressure; the brake control modulates the pressure sent to the brakes during braking.
evidence: https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150100033.pdf p. 15, Combined Unloader 975 303: controllo automatico della pressione di esercizio e alimentazione dei serbatoi.
https://dld.utah.gov/cdl-manual-section-5-air-brakes/ §§5.1.2 e 5.1.7: il regolatore controlla i cicli del compressore; la pressione applicata dal pedale comanda la frenata.

rows.text: The brake governor controls the system supply pressure; it does not directly control air suspension pressure.
evidence: https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150100033.pdf p. 15, Combined Unloader 975 303: controllo automatico della pressione di esercizio dell’impianto frenante.

https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/air_suspension_maintenance_manuals/MM1315_web_2.pdf p. 2: la centralina OptiRide regola la pressione dei soffietti della sospensione.

rows.text: Air suspension does not replace the governor: the brake supply still needs pressure control.
evidence: https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150100033.pdf p. 15, Combined Unloader 975 303: il regolatore controlla automaticamente la pressione di esercizio dei freni.

https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/air_suspension_maintenance_manuals/MM1315_web_2.pdf p. 2: la sospensione OptiRide usa un controllo proprio della pressione dei soffietti.

rows.text: The governor acts automatically according to air pressure, without a hand control operated by the driver.
evidence: https://www.wabco-customercentre.com/catalog/docs/8150102173.pdf §6.1.1.1: regolatore 975 303 controlla automaticamente la pressione e comprende valvola di sicurezza integrata.

https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/air_processing_maintenance_manuals_/MM1736_web.pdf §4.2.5: il regolatore comanda carico e scarico del compressore alle soglie di pressione.

rows.text: In a drum brake, shoes lined with friction material press against the drum to slow the wheel.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/dmv/pages/online_cdl_manual_2/section_5.aspx §§5.1.8, 5.4.5: ganasce e tamburo, pastiglie e disco; attrito genera calore e uso eccessivo provoca surriscaldamento e fading.

rows.text: In a disc brake, pads lined with friction material press against the disc to slow the wheel.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/dmv/pages/online_cdl_manual_2/section_5.aspx §§5.1.8, 5.4.5: ganasce e tamburo, pastiglie e disco; attrito genera calore e uso eccessivo provoca surriscaldamento e fading.

rows.text: Heavy vehicle service brakes use friction: for example, pads press on a disc or shoes on a drum.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/dmv/pages/online_cdl_manual_2/section_5.aspx §§5.1.8, 5.4.5: ganasce e tamburo, pastiglie e disco; attrito genera calore e uso eccessivo provoca surriscaldamento e fading.

rows.text: Friction produces heat; prolonged or excessive use can overheat brakes and reduce their effectiveness.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/dmv/pages/online_cdl_manual_2/section_5.aspx §§5.1.8, 5.4.5: ganasce e tamburo, pastiglie e disco; attrito genera calore e uso eccessivo provoca surriscaldamento e fading.

rows.text: In friction brakes, energy of motion is converted into heat that must be dissipated into the surroundings.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/dmv/pages/online_cdl_manual_2/section_5.aspx §§5.1.8, 5.4.5: ganasce e tamburo, pastiglie e disco; attrito genera calore e uso eccessivo provoca surriscaldamento e fading.

rows.text: In a conventional disc brake the pads act on the disc; shoes are associated with the drum.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/dmv/pages/online_cdl_manual_2/section_5.aspx §§5.1.8, 5.4.5: ganasce e tamburo, pastiglie e disco; attrito genera calore e uso eccessivo provoca surriscaldamento e fading.

rows.text: Shoes and pads belong to different types of brake: shoes act on a drum and pads on a disc.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/dmv/pages/online_cdl_manual_2/section_5.aspx §§5.1.8, 5.4.5: ganasce e tamburo, pastiglie e disco; attrito genera calore e uso eccessivo provoca surriscaldamento e fading.

rows.text: The typical problem is overheating from friction; ventilation helps dissipate heat.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/dmv/pages/online_cdl_manual_2/section_5.aspx §§5.1.8, 5.4.5: l’attrito produce calore e l’uso eccessivo surriscalda i freni.

https://special.mercedes-benz-trucks.com/en/the-e-econic/technical-data/downloads.html “Technical data at a glance” e “Brakes”: eEconic ha massa complessiva 19 o 27 t e dischi a ventilazione interna su tutti gli assi.

Sathiyan et al., “Experimental thermal analysis of brake cooling relative to mass flow of air through a ventilated brake disc”, Case Studies in Thermal Engineering 64 (2024), 105530, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.csite.2024.105530, testo completo https://research.chalmers.se/publication/543957/file/543957_Fulltext.pdf, §1 p. 1: la rotazione aspira aria attraverso le alette del disco ventilato; la convezione forzata favorisce la dissipazione del calore.

rows.text: Heavy vehicle service brakes normally use friction, with discs or drums; an electromagnetic retarder, if fitted, is a separate device.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/dmv/pages/online_cdl_manual_2/section_5.aspx §§5.1.8, 5.4.5: ganasce e tamburo, pastiglie e disco; attrito genera calore e uso eccessivo provoca surriscaldamento e fading.
https://www.fmcsa.dot.gov/carrier-safety/carrier-safety-resources/motorcoach-brake-systems-and-safety-technologies: freni a disco e a tamburo per veicoli pesanti; il rallentatore è distinto.

rows.text: Exceeding 7.5 tonnes does not require liquid-cooled brakes: air-cooled disc brakes exist for heavy vehicles.
evidence: https://special.mercedes-benz-trucks.com/en/the-e-econic/technical-data/downloads.html “Technical data at a glance” e “Brakes”: eEconic ha massa complessiva 19 o 27 t e dischi a ventilazione interna di serie su tutti gli assi.

https://special.mercedes-benz-trucks.com/it/leeconic/dati-tecnici/equipaggiamento/sistemi-di-assistenza-per-la-sicurezza.html “Freni”: freni a disco autoventilanti dell’eEconic; https://special.mercedes-benz-trucks.com/it/econic-servizi-municipali/generalita/applicazione.html: versione per raccolta rifiuti da 27 t sul mercato italiano.

Sathiyan et al., “Experimental thermal analysis of brake cooling relative to mass flow of air through a ventilated brake disc”, Case Studies in Thermal Engineering 64 (2024), 105530, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.csite.2024.105530, testo completo https://research.chalmers.se/publication/543957/file/543957_Fulltext.pdf, §1 p. 1: la rotazione aspira aria attraverso le alette del disco ventilato; la convezione forzata favorisce la dissipazione del calore.

rows.text: Vehicles over 3.5 tonnes can also have ventilated discs; ventilation helps dissipate heat.
evidence: https://special.mercedes-benz-trucks.com/en/the-e-econic/technical-data/downloads.html “Technical data at a glance” e “Brakes”: eEconic ha massa complessiva 19 o 27 t e dischi a ventilazione interna su tutti gli assi.

rows.text: In an air-over-hydraulic brake, compressed air acts on a device that generates hydraulic force; fluid then transmits that force to the brakes.
evidence: https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf §6: nei freni pneumo-idraulici la pressione dell’aria è convertita in forza idraulica per azionare i freni.

issues: 30388, 30390, 30397, 30398, 30399: The cited WABCO 8150502173.pdf §4.8 diagram could not be inspected: the browser rejected the PDF as too large. Replace or supplement with an accessible exact source and verify the claimed diagram. WABCO https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/air_processing_technical_publications/TP971.pdf depicts a dryer upstream of multiple reservoirs; https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150100033.pdf pp. 15 and 20 describes automatic supply control and the system arrangement. These independent sources do not verify the cited diagram itself.

30388: The cited ZF air dryer product page confirms moisture and oil-aerosol separation, but its accessible text does not establish the draft evidence claim that this product includes a governor and purge valve. Cite a specific accessible technical reference supporting that claim or remove the unsupported evidence assertion.

30395: The cited WABCO 9753039503.pdf page 2 is image-only and could not be inspected in this review. The WABCO 975 303 operating description at https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150100033.pdf p. 15 supports exhaust during the unloaded phase, but the exact cited document remains unverified; provide accessible evidence or replace the citation.

30408, 30411: The cited Brembo 150.65 catalogue page could not be opened, so its specific vehicle mass and ventilated-disc fitment cannot be verified from the cited evidence. Provide an accessible manufacturer catalogue that establishes both fitment and a mass over 3.5 tonnes; Oregon confirms overheating, but does not verify this vehicle-specific citation.

30410: The cited Knorr-Bremse references separately mention disc brakes for vehicles up to 44 tonnes and a ventilated disc used in commercial vehicles, but do not establish a particular air-cooled brake fitted to a road vehicle above 7.5 tonnes or the asserted Italian legal conclusion. Provide an authoritative, applicable provision or a verified qualifying vehicle/fitment example and supporting evidence for the cooling method.
